title: November 2025: Custom moderation, deeper analytics, bulk duplication, and a smarter Sparky
summary: This update is all about giving teachers and admins more control, clarity, and convenience. Plus, an even sharper Sparky to power it all.
body_markdown:
November’s here: ‘tis the season of grading marathons, report cards, and “wait, how is it almost winter break?” moments. We can’t help with your coffee supply (yet), but we *can* make your Flint experience smoother, smarter, and a lot more fun.


This month’s updates are all about giving you more control and clarity, from giving you **finer moderation settings** and **better analytics** to letting you **duplicate activities** in bulk and rely on **Sparky’s ever-growing brain** .


So grab that extra-large mug, take a deep breath, and let’s dive in ☕.


## 🔒 Custom moderation categories


You can now customize which moderation categories trigger email notifications. Choose exactly what you want to be alerted about, from **harassment** , **hate** , and **illicit content** to **sexual** , **violence** , and **self-harm** flags, so your inbox stays focused on what matters most to your community.


This is based on feedback from admins who wanted fine-grained safety settings and more proactive responses when moderation is needed.


## 📊 Enhanced subject activity analysis


**See what’s being taught, down to the detail.**


Click into the **pie chart breakdown** (for example, “English”) to open a second-level view, showing how many activities are debates, grammar exercises, poetry analyses, writing prompts, reading-comprehension lessons, and more!


## 🧩 Bulk activity duplication


**Copy once. Use everywhere.** Teachers can now **duplicate activities to multiple groups at once.** This resolves the arduous and manual process of duplicating activities one-by-one for each group. Now it’s time to say goodbye to tedious copy-pasting across class sections!


## 📬 Session analysis notifications


Whenever a **student session finishes analyzing** , you’ll now receive an **email notification** so you don’t have to keep the tab open and play the waiting game. This is especially great when you are having a hectic day and just want to be notified, rather than having to jump into Flint every few minutes to check how your student’s are performing.


## ⚡ Core model upgrade to Sonnet 4.5


**Sparky just got smarter.** We’ve upgraded Flint’s core model from **Sonnet 4 to 4.5** , improving fluency, accuracy, and responsiveness across all chats and activity generation. Expect **clearer explanations** , **faster responses** , and an even more **personalized AI experience** for students.
